Table rows read as option sentences (Blessings of Khorne) and a bullet's "**Name:**" as its option (Surging Vitality). Per the builder's BOXES diff only the 4 named stat boxes are new; LS now accepts a table row's sentence as the quote. Re-rolls are not read: the chargeAdd/advanceAdd patterns need "add N"/"has +N".

Patterns need a number added or subtracted, so no re-roll is read as a roll change (Battle-lust's re-roll, Bloody Fury and the others listed have no box). The foe test now leaves "this unit has +1" (The Scent of Blood) as its own. The 4 new stat boxes fall back (reader2 does not read Charge): AGREE 61→65, nothing counted, each drawn from its words with its summary. Non-blocking: The Scent of Blood's snc quotes only its +1 sentence, and the "Or: … +2" sentence has no snc entry. The line's summary says both.

"For each X this model is equipped with" is read as an addition per X, counted after swaps (swaps come before adds in acts). A name-alone alternative is read as one of it. A swap of "X and Y" counts gear of the swap's model. "later" holds Split models. A choice with nothing read is unread, never empty. I reran from-waha.js for world-eaters and chaos-daemons in a scratch copy: no WARGEAR OPTIONS left unread.

couldTouch is meant to mean "no rule reaching the unit could change it", but it misses rules that do.

1. Failure case (made up, built with builder.js): the Chaos Daemons catalogue's Keeper of Secrets added to the Tzeeeeentch export (in place of a Lord of Change), every melee AP one better than GW's. It BUILDS with GW's -2 and the note "Ritual knife, Snapping claws, Witstealer sword AP -3 in the export, -2 by GW". But GW's Daemon Lord of Slaanesh (Aura) says "While a friendly SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit is within 6\" of this model, improve the Armour Penetration of melee weapons in that unit by 1", and Core Rules 22.01 says "While a model with an aura ability is on the battlefield, it is always within range of its own aura ability". So the export's -3 is GW's value with a rule of the unit, and the app shows -2. That is silently wrong: the sheet has no mark, and the Overview note says GW's value is -2. Main refused this.

Why it is missed:
- (a) FIELD_WORDS needs "<stat> … characteristic" or an abbreviation with a value. It misses "improve the Armour Penetration of", "N+ InSv" (Synaptoprescience, Leader-beasts, Moment Shackle, Eagle's Eye word it so), "+6\" R" and spelled "+1 Strength".
- (b) The raw-box path still filters boxes through onOk, so a box with a condition the list does not settle (target keyword, aura, quoted clause) never counts as "could change". Contrary to its comment ("counted or not"), only words then guard it.
- (c) The three Chaos Daemons, Custodes and Tyranids catalogues are not read, so their catalogue-only datasheets and unused detachments have no box at all: words are the only guard there.

2. Coverage: the three flipped build-parity tests (Tyrannofex T14, Hurricanis AP-4, Gun Stock WS4+) used to prove "an unexplained value is refused". Nothing replaces them with a test of the words path (a rule with no box whose words name the field) or of an aura on its own unit.

3. Visibility: the value appears only once, as a note at the foot of the Overview ("On this phone"). The unit sheet shows GW's value with no mark (phone-murderband.txt: Lord Invocatus's sheet shows 4+, nothing more). Neither says a rule could be the cause.

4. Lord Invocatus Bolt pistol: Wahapedia prints BS 4+ (ds/world-eaters_Lord-Invocatus.html), New Recruit 2+. The pack has no update to that weapon's BS. A 4+ BS on a character whose melee is 2+ is unusual. Before the note tells the friend "4+ by GW", confirm GW's own figure (Codex or GW app). This branch cannot check it.

fix.fix:
Required:
- builder.js couldTouch: count every raw box that changes the field whatever its conditions (no onOk on the could-change path).
- Widen FIELD_WORDS: "improve/worsen the <stat> of", "N+ InSv", "+N\" R", spelled "+N Strength/Attacks/Toughness/Damage", "Range".
- Treat an aura of the unit itself as reaching it (Core Rules 22.01).
- Add import-test cases that must refuse: Keeper of Secrets AP-3 (aura on its own unit), and a not-read catalogue enhancement worded "N+ InSv".
- Show the taken value on the unit's row too (a mark such as "GW’s 4+; the export: 2+"), not only at the Overview's foot.
